files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/meetings_files/', entry_type='files')
base_dir = '~/documents/work/meetings_files/'
for file_path in files:
    # Extract file name from path
    file_name = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on '__' to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = file_name.split('__', 1)
    # Split rest on last dot to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name_part, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name_part = rest
        ext = ''
    # Create directory for file_name_part
    dest_dir = base_dir + file_name_part + '/'
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=dest_dir, recursive=True)
    # Destination file path
    dest_file = dest_dir + date_part + ('.' + ext if ext else '')
    # Move file
    print(f"Moving {file_path} to {dest_file}")
    apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=dest_file)
